title: Give notice of a court order in respect of date of dissolution (AM24)
text:
This form can be used to notify Companies House of a court order in respect of date of dissolution.

 Use the continuation page to tell us of other insolvency practitioners, if more than 2 are acting.
changeNote: Added newest version of the form to give notice of a court order in respect of date of dissolution (AM24).
